name: Cipher
description: Handles onboarding and app settings — names, models, API key, and toggles.

name: Atlas
description: Reads and searches the documents (Markdown, text, CSV, PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML, OpenDocument, legacy .doc/.xls, and code/data files) you've added to the knowledge base, and browses the folders you've attached to it.

name: Explorer
description: Searches the live web and reads pages for up-to-date information beyond your knowledge base.

name: Chrono
description: Manages reminders and prompt tasks — one-shot or recurring, with dynamic parameters — and notifies you when they're due.

name: Pilot
description: Controls a real, visible browser to navigate websites, read live pages, fill forms, and click through multi-step flows — including sites you're logged into.
